en.basel-kadem: 67.	We were told by Hasan bin Ahmad bin Idrees, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by my father, from Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Yahya bin Imran al-Ash’ari, from Ya’qoub bin Yazid, from Muhammed bin Ibrahim al-Nawfali, from Hussain bin Mukhtar, with a chain of narrators that he ascribed, having said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Cursed, cursed, is the one who causes permanent blindness to a blinded! Cursed, cursed, is the one who worships the dinar and the dirham! Cursed, cursed, is the one who has intercourse with an animal!
